$comment: Fit feedback is present only where the reviewer supplied it. Small-sample fit data is never presented as authoritative.

reviews.title: Genuinely comfortable for long runs
reviews.body: I have put about 200 km on these now and the cushioning has held up much better than my previous pair. The mesh upper breathes well in humid weather, which was my main worry. Sizing was spot on for me — I take a 9 in most brands and the 9 UK fits with a thumb's width at the front. The only thing I would flag is that the laces are a little short if you use a runner's knot, but that is a five-rupee fix. Would buy again without hesitating.
